definition: one that causes the death of another
description: The African savanna in hazy golden light. A spotted leopard lies stretched along the thick branch of a lone acacia tree, its long tail hanging down and curling at the tip. Draped over the same branch next to its head hangs the limp body of a small brown antelope it has caught, its thin legs dangling in the air. The leopard opens its mouth in a wide yawn, then lays its head down beside the antelope and rests. Below the tree, tall dry golden grass stretches away to low hills on the horizon.
